sources.title: [2605.29257] ChildVox: A Speech, Audio, and Large Audio-Language Model ...
sources.snippet: We present ChildVox, a novel benchmark for characterizing the diverse acoustic signals through which children communicate. Specifically, ChildVox follows the full developmental trajectory from birth through school age, covering physiological sounds, non-linguistic vocalizations, canonical syllables, and spoken language.
